sources.title: Area-Efficient In-Memory Computing for Mixture-of-Experts via Multiplexing and Caching
sources.venue: ISCAS2026 pp.912-916; DOI10.1109/ISCAS66217.2026.11562485 per official artifact README
sources.read_depth: Abstract, introduction/background, architecture/grouping/scheduling SectionsIII.A-D and experimental setup SectionIV.A. Not all plots/appendix results; only five-page paper available.
sources.evidence: Proposes peripheral sharing, load-aware grouping, prefill rescheduling and GO cache. Describes simulation based on3DCIM. Setup cites HERMES256x256 crossbars with8-bit I/O; this is not a NAND chip measurement. No NAND occurrence found in this manuscript.
sources.inference: Useful published shared-peripheral placement backend; its new cache or architectural changes are not imported into the present probes. Reported performance numbers are not used as empirical calibration.

sources.title: MoEwithPIM official author artifact
sources.read_depth: README/NOTICE, complete Tier/Linear/base/MoELayer numerical paths, mapping functions, tracer, pertinent graph pruning/communication and scheduler resource/latency paths. Native imports, CPU numerical probes, FX traces and schedules executed.
evidence: accelerator.py:462-494 tier_linear calls F.linear(token,weight.T), Tier pads input and selects its own stored weight.
modules/linear.py:45-127 splits input by tier rows, calls fixed(tile,tier)weights, digital_add reduces input partitions, and output partitions concatenate.
modules/base.py:17-53 programs weights according to mapping; input/output fringe dimensions shadow the tile geometry local variables, causing a reproduced600x700 programming assertion.
modules/moe.py:108-109 takes topk values but obtains indices from synthetic sampling rather than the actual topk indices.
mapping/mapper.py:58-170 GREEDY_TOP2 uses joint density to order experts;340-490 allocates weight rectangles across tile/tier capacity.
inference/scheduler.py:266-440 enforces one active MVM per tile when model_ott=True; tier address selects stored weight, tile address defines analog contention.
graph/utils.py:17-29 IMPORTANT_NODES has MVM,ReLU/GELU,ADD,communication,etc.; router softmax/topk and gate multiplications have no separate timed operator.
plotting modules are tracked and native import passes; rg ignore output was not a valid missing-file test.
sources.maturity: Executable ideal torch.float32 operator simulator plus abstract event scheduler; no fabricatedNAND precision or commercial hardware timing contract.

sources.title: 3D-CiM-LLM-Inference-Simulator
sources.read_depth: README/requirements, original native accelerator/Linear/base/MoELayer/Mapper source and scheduler differences. Same numerical and schedule probes executed without upstream edits.
sources.evidence: Official README calls this an abstract3D AIMC accelerator simulator and asks users to implement/calibrate operation timing/energy functions. Linear.py,base.py,moe.py and mapper.py are byte-identical to the Gao artifact commit; accelerator/scheduler/graph-processing differ. Both native imports execute.
sources.inference: GREEDY_TOP2 and dense column-partial accumulation predate the2026 derivative artifact. Two artifact executions validate software contracts, not two independent physical chip measurements.

sources.title: Efficient scaling of large language models with mixture of experts and3D analog in-memory computing
sources.read_depth: Primary article search-visible abstract/code-availability/contribution text plus the official IBM repository. Full publisher PDF was not obtained due public identity-provider redirect.
sources.evidence: Code availability directly links IBM/analog-moe and IBM/3D-CiM-LLM-Inference-Simulator. Article describes simulation on abstract3D NVM AIMC; it does not establish the present CPU F.linear path as a calibratedNAND numerical model.
sources.not_claimed: No unobserved paper-page ABI, reset signal, physical precision or numerical non-ideality result is inferred.

sources.title: analog-moe official numerical training extension
sources.read_depth: Official README install/test/conversion interface only; package not installed or executed.
sources.evidence: README describes AIHWKIT-Lightning AnalogSigmaMoELayer conversion and test_moe_layer.py; Triton and other dependencies are required. This is a separate hardware-aware numerical path from the ideal Tier F.linear simulator.
sources.not_claimed: No noise-aware or quantized-model accuracy test was run; no weights/models downloaded.
